title: XDrip Prefs. display wrong BT Collector name
symptom: The xDrip preferences dialog displays 'LimiTTer' as BT Collector instead of the expected 'Blucon' when using a Blucon collector. Later, after connecting a Miaomiao reader, the display still shows 'LimiTTer' and the toast says 'LimiTTer Collector Started on Watch'.
evidence_quote: The xDrip preferences dialog displays "LimiTTer" as BT Collector. "Blucon" would be expected.
